title: About this task
paragraphs: Project 1 of TRAVELS assesses the needs for autonomous vehicles (AVs) among different user groups in rural areas, including individuals with disabilities. It builds on a senior mobility transportation needs survey conducted by UWM for WisDOT, which covered more than 70 counties, 13 transit agencies, and 83 service providers. UWM leads the task, with Oklahoma State University supporting rural demand work and Northern Oklahoma College supporting other demand work.

tasks.title: 1. User needs and expectations survey
tasks.text: Collects what different rural user groups need, expect, and prefer from AV services.

tasks.title: 2. RAV demand forecasting
tasks.text: Projects demand using demographic trends, economic factors, and the state of existing transportation infrastructure.
